rca_of_issue: Iteration_1 P0 (SOS modal controls unreachable): root cause was tall non-scrollable View inside modal - fixed with KeyboardAwareScrollView; retest confirms normal taps at 390x844. Iteration_1 P1 (badge overflow): root cause was unshrinking title in statusTop row - fixed with flexShrink:1 on heading; measured badge right edge 342px within 390px viewport. Initial pytest run showed 9 failures, but RCA showed pytest-xdist (-n 2 from pytest.ini addopts) splitting stateful test classes across workers; sequential rerun passed 23/23.
